as_a_slide: Structurally it does the job. All five zones are free of objects, edges and shadows, and white type will be legible in each. But the zones vary from luminance 40 to 94 and the header is a ramp, so the text block will look unevenly lit. The armchair is the visual hero, the Tropos are dark and murky, and the green looks self-lit rather than like lamps in a room. With c1 to c4 it would carry the text calmly and present the products as the family.
